newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says China order report not new.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says China order report not new.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Monday that media reports over the weekend about it winning an order in China worth 870 million crowns concerned an old contract.
"We already sent out a release about that order (on July 2)", Ericsson spokeswoman Lill-Laras Lindgren told Reuters.
The old release said the order value $110 million, or 852 million crowns. Ericsson won the GSM expansion order from Heilongjiang Posts and Telecommunications Administration (HLJPTA).
A Swedish news agency and Swedish radio reported the order on Saturday. At the time Ericsson in Sweden could neither confirm nor deny the report and no one could be reached at Ericsson in China.
